author: thinkingsao
quote: So I hoped people were wrong about this game, as I heard how bad it was from other people. But I loved GTA 5, and really my favorite of all time GTA 4. But so far it is just so boring to play. As a main character Jason is not interesting, and when I look at my favorite character Niko in GTA 4 I just wonder how they made Jason so uninteresting. The first few hours of the game is mostly chore type missions, and things Lucia wants you to do. But it just feels annoying to play. I think I would rather play GTA 4 again than sit through more of this. Look at GTA 5, and how much interesting side characters they added, and the cool side missions. GTA 6 at least so far has very few interesting side characters. I was thinking this game was going to be a cool Bonnie and Clyde type of gangster game. But it turns out its like a chore simulator with some sprinkled in moments of fun. Honestly going to see if I can refund this game.
